page.overview:
Who is Cruelty?

is a demon aspirant in the Candescent Creed, and one of the three sisters of Tyranny. As an NPC, is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Cruelty is slightly shorter than her sister Tyranny, but stunning, with ruby red lips, small pronged silvery horns, and a whipping tail. Tyranny believed she was "very, very smart."

Tyranny met all three of her sisters at the Villa Aurora the day after Thjazi Fang's execution. Cruelty was pleased that Wicander had appeared at the funeral of someone the Sundered Houses had just executed, saying that it sent a clear message about their values. She found it amusing that Wicander truly believed and held true to the Tenets of the Whispered Light.

Cruelty was present in Riesingürtle when the Seekers arrived there. Her sister Enmity had encountered the group at a biergarten, posing as a ditzy missionary of the Candescent Creed, and learning from Thaisha Lloy her real name and that she had met both Tyranny and Wicander Halovar at the Lloy family estate. When Enmity joined her sisters at the Candescent Cathedral, she told them what she had learned from Thaisha. The sisters, who were searching for Wicander and Tyranny, suspected that Occtis Tachonis was actually Wick in disguise, and that Vaelus was Tyranny. They returned to the biergarten in search of the group, who had by that time left it.
